battle.name: 日德蘭
battle.brief: 一九一六年五月三十一日至六月一日，英國大艦隊與德國公海艦隊在日德蘭半島以西的北海相遇。戰鬥巡洋艦在前，雙方在海霧與砲煙裡以十三吋以上主砲對射；雄獅號為比蒂中將旗艦，在極遠距離首先開火，隨後遭「盧措號」集中射擊，十四發命中中六發屬大口徑，因艙門及時關閉而未重演「胡德」號的殉爆。

kit.name: 雄獅
kit.history: 比蒂的戰巡旗艦。日德蘭 Q 砲塔起火，因為艙門與裝藥紀律沒有演成胡德那種殉爆。戰巡的賭注是速度換裝甲。

countries: 交戰雙方是英國大艦隊與德國公海艦隊，爭的是北海的制海權與英國封鎖線的存廢。英方由海軍元帥約翰・傑利科伊坐鎮，旗艦為「鐵王」號戰鬥艦，總隊共有十八艘主力艦，編入第一至第四戰鬥艦支隊；戰鬥巡洋艦支隊由海軍中將大衛・比蒂率領，旗艦正是雄獅號（HMS Lion），第一中隊轄皇家公主號、瑪麗皇后號、老虎號、紐西蘭號，第二中隊有不屈號（Indefatigable）、無畏號（Invincible）與無敵號（Inflexible），頑強號（Indomitable）因傳動故障留在斯卡帕灣，未能參戰。英方另以輕巡洋艦幕僚、裝甲巡洋艦支隊與多支驅逐艦分隊護衛主力線。德方公海艦隊由海軍上將海因里希・舍爾率領，旗艦「腓特烈大帝號」，下轄戰鬥艦分隊與第三戰鬥巡洋艦中隊；打前鋒的先遣部隊由海軍中將弗朗茨・希珀指揮，旗艦「盧措號」，其戰鬥巡洋艦中隊五艘為盧措、莫爾特凱、塞德利茨、馮・德・坦、德弗林格，兩翼由巡洋艦分遣隊與驅逐艦分隊護衛。雙方都是「大艦隊在後、旗艦在前」的指揮架構：英方靠巡洋艦幕僚遮蔽主力線，德方靠驅逐艦前置施行魚雷突襲，旗艦的處置幾乎決定每一階段的節奏。
countriesEn: The two sides were the British Grand Fleet and the German High Seas Fleet, and what was at stake was command of the North Sea and the survival of the British blockade. On the British side the command sat with Admiral of the Fleet John Jellicoe, whose flagship was the battleship Iron Duke; the fleet numbered eighteen capital ships distributed among the 1st to 4th Battle Squadrons. The Battlecruiser Force was led by Vice Admiral David Beatty, flying his flag in the very ship on this card, HMS Lion; the 1st Battlecruiser Squadron had Princess Royal, Queen Mary, Tiger and New Zealand, and the 2nd Battlecruiser Squadron had Indefatigable, Invincible and Inflexible, while Indomitable stayed at Scapa Flow with a transmission fault and did not fight. The British also screened the battle line with a cruiser screen, an armoured cruiser squadron and several destroyer flotillas. On the German side the High Seas Fleet was commanded by Admiral Reinhard Scheer from Friedrich der Grosse, with his battle squadrons and 3rd Battlecruiser Squadron under him; the advance force that led the way was commanded by Vice Admiral Franz von Hipper from Lützow, and his battlecruiser squadron of five ships was Lützow, Moltke, Seydlitz, Von der Tann and Derfflinger, with cruiser detachments and destroyer flotillas out on the wings. Both sides ran on the same pattern, a fleet in the rear and a flagship in front: the British covered the battle line with a cruiser screen, the Germans pushed destroyers forward for torpedo attacks, and the handling of the flagship decided the tempo of every phase.
people: 關鍵人物集中在十幾個人身上。英方總指揮傑利科伊上將在大艦隊旗艦「鐵王」號上，他當日下午只收到零碎電報，十七時五十五分下令全隊轉向離開，以免在劣視距下被拖入夜戰，又在十九時前後下令掉頭反擊；比蒂中將在雄獅號上指揮戰鬥巡洋艦支隊，十七時四十五分發出要求逼近敵隊的命令，隨後雄獅號在極遠距離首先開火，該命令的措辭在日後的官方戰史兩派之間一直有爭議。雄獅號艦長艾尼爾・查特菲爾德中校當時才二十五歲，日後成為海軍元帥。英方第二戰鬥巡洋艦中隊的戰鬥巡洋艦支隊副指揮官查爾斯・溫圖爾中將坐鎮「無畏號」，該艦爆炸時殉職；同中隊副指揮官霍勒斯・胡德中校在「無敵號」上，該艦遭魚雷擊中後沉沒，他與旗艦官一同陣亡。德方由公海艦隊總司令舍爾上將在「腓特烈大帝號」上坐鎮，力主在夜間結束戰鬥；希珀中將在「盧措號」上率先遣隊衝鋒，午後「盧措事件」中該艦前砲塔被輕巡洋艦的砲彈擊中傾側，艦上有人主張撤退；希珀參謀組提出的先退出射界、避免讓英國戰鬥艦反覆進入射程的建議，實質改變了德方部署。夜里舍爾下令以驅逐艦實施魚雷突擊，試圖撕開英軍戰列線。
peopleEn: The decisions rested in the hands of a dozen or so men. On the British side the overall commander, Admiral of the Fleet Jellicoe, was aboard the battleship Iron Duke with the Grand Fleet; he received only fragmentary reports through the afternoon, ordered the fleet to turn away at 17:55 so as not to be drawn into a night action in poor visibility, and then ordered the about-turn that produced the counter-attack around 19:00. Beatty, a vice admiral, commanded the Battlecruiser Force from the Lion and at 17:45 signalled the order to close on the enemy, the Lion opening fire at extreme range shortly afterwards; the exact wording of that signal has been disputed ever since between the two schools of official Jutland history. Lion's captain, Lieutenant Commander Ernle Chatfield, was only twenty-five years old and later became an Admiral of the Fleet. Charles Wintour, the second-in-command of the Battlecruiser Force, was in Invincible and was killed when she blew up; Horace Hood, second-in-command of the 2nd Battlecruiser Squadron, was in Inflexible and went down with the ship when a torpedo struck her, losing his life along with his flag captain. On the German side Admiral Scheer, commanding the High Seas Fleet from Friedrich der Grosse, pressed for the engagement to be broken off at night, while Vice Admiral Hipper led the advance force from Lützow; in the Lützow incident that afternoon the forward turret of his flagship was hit and heeled over by shells from a light cruiser, and some aboard urged a withdrawal. The staff advice of Hipper's command, to pull out of the range of the British battle fleet and refuse to be drawn back into it, in substance reshaped the German deployment. That night Scheer ordered a torpedo attack by the destroyers in an attempt to tear a gap in the British line of battle.
kits: 卡面這件雄獅號是伊麗莎白女王級的頭號戰鬥巡洋艦，1911 年在維克斯造船廠開工，1912 年八月下水、同年十月入役，標準排水量約兩萬二千五百長噸，艇長約二百零七公尺，舷寬約二十七公尺，最大航速二十五節，乘員約一千人。它裝八門十三又二分之一吋主砲，分置四座雙聯裝砲塔，彈重約一千四百磅，射程可達兩萬碼，射速每分鐘兩發；裝甲帶與砲座厚十三吋，砲塔正面厚十五吋，正是以速度換裝甲的典型設計——火力與主力艦同級，裝甲卻比同期主力艦薄，一旦被打中，內部要害空間極易受創。雄獅號在日德蘭的表現完全印證這一點：它以約一萬八千碼的極遠距離率先向德軍戰鬥巡洋艦中隊開火，隨後被「盧措號」集中射擊，先後中了十四發，其中六發為大口徑命中，一發穿透水線下方淹進前部彈藥艙，艙門及時關閉、裝藥紀律嚴格，沒有重演「胡德」號那種殉爆；結果九人陣亡、二十五人受傷，航速一度跌到十七節，勉強退出戰線。同一場戰鬥中，姊妹艦不屈號與無畏號被重創後爆炸沉沒，皇家公主號因後部爆炸沉沒，老虎號重創生還，無敵號被魚雷擊中後沉沒。除主砲外，兩軍還用上三吋高射砲、二十一吋魚雷、潛望鏡與火控測距儀；英軍出動四架皇家海軍航空隊的索普威斯「駱駝」式戰鬥機攻擊「塞德利茨號」與德軍驅逐艦分隊，德方則以水上飛機轟炸英軍巡洋艦並擊落一架英軍偵察機。主力艦全靠燃油在海上自行續航，進港維修依靠斯卡帕灣與羅西思基地。
kitsEn: The ship on the card face, HMS Lion, was the leading battlecruiser of the Queen Elizabeth class, begun at Vickers in 1911, launched in August 1912 and commissioned that October, with a standard displacement of about 22,500 long tons, a length of roughly 207 metres, a beam of about 27 metres, a top speed of 25 knots and a complement of around a thousand men. She carried eight 13.5-inch guns in four twin turrets, firing a shell of about 1,400 pounds with a range of some 20,000 yards at two rounds a minute each; the belt and barbettes were thirteen inches thick and the turret faces fifteen. This was the classic exchange of speed for armour: the firepower of a capital ship on the protection of something thinner, and once a hit landed the spaces around the vital organs were very easy to open up. The Lion at Jutland demonstrated the point exactly. She opened fire on the German battlecruiser squadron at extreme range, about 18,000 yards, and was then concentrated upon by Lützow, taking fourteen hits of which six were heavy-calibre, one passing below the waterline and flooding the forward magazine; the magazine doors were shut in time and the ammunition-handling discipline held, so she avoided the sort of magazine explosion that had destroyed Hood. Nine men were killed and twenty-five wounded, her speed fell at one point to seventeen knots, and she was able to disengage. In the same battle her sisters Indefatigable and Invincible were destroyed by explosions after heavy damage, Princess Royal blew up aft, Tiger survived severe damage, and Inflexible was torpedoed and sank. Beyond the main guns both fleets used three-inch high-angle guns, twenty-one-inch torpedoes, periscopes and fire-control rangefinders; the Royal Naval Air Service sent four Sopwith Camels to attack Seydlitz and the German destroyer flotillas, while German seaplanes bombed British cruisers and shot down a British reconnaissance aircraft. The capital ships refuelled at sea on their own bunker coal and oil, and their dockyard repairs depended on Scapa Flow and Rosyth.
tactics: 日德蘭是一場典型的高速主力對撞，戰術核心在戰鬥巡洋艦支隊。英方把戰鬥巡洋艦放在最前，第二中隊與第一中隊相隔約一萬碼交錯前出，配以輕巡洋艦幕僚遮蔽射界；德方則讓五艘戰鬥巡洋艦在先鋒驅逐艦掩護下直撲英軍戰線，意圖在主力艦隊趕到前削薄英方陣頭。十七時五十分左右，雙方在濃霧與砲煙中於一萬五千至一萬八千碼的距離互相看不清全貌，只能靠短暫的視界窗口瞄準，而當時的太陽正落在德方一方的背後，英國艦隊在逆光中被看成一排黑影。英方嚴令戰鬥巡洋艦支隊不得使用探照燈、不得主動發射魚雷，因為魚雷瞄準具要留給後方主力艦使用，這條命令使英方在最需要重火力的階段無法對穿過己方戰線的德軍發動魚雷攻擊。十八時三十分左右，英方第一、第二戰鬥巡洋艦中隊穿過德軍戰鬥巡洋艦與戰列線之間的空隙衝入，形成所謂的縱隊突進；但英方在穿越時沒有把八門主砲集中射向同一目標，而是分成小組各自追擊不同敵艦，被後世批評為射擊分散。主力線接戰後，傑利科伊在十七時五十五分下令轉向離開，十九時前後再掉頭反擊，由戰列線尾端向德軍射擊，主力艦隊的交叉射擊是全日最大規模的齊射之一。夜間德方以驅逐艦實施魚雷突擊，英方不願在劣視距下接戰，改以「彩虹」警戒幕攔截德軍魚雷隊，撤退途中的「盧措號」擱淺在日德蘭西岸的灘塗上，成為傷亡最慘重的單船事件之一。
tacticsEn: Jutland was a collision of fast capital fleets at high speed, and the tactical centre of it was the Battlecruiser Force. The British put the battlecruisers in front, the 1st and 2nd Battlecruiser Squadrons running out in a staggered line about ten thousand yards apart, screened by the light cruiser force, while the Germans drove their five battlecruisers straight at the British line under cover of the leading destroyer flotillas, hoping to thin the head of the British formation before the battle fleet could arrive. Around 17:50 the two sides, in haze and cordite smoke and at ranges between fifteen and eighteen thousand yards, could see only fragments of each other and had to fire through the short windows of visibility that came and went, and the sun was then behind the German ships, so the British line stood out in silhouette. The British battlecruiser force was strictly forbidden to use searchlights or to fire torpedoes, because the torpedo spotters were needed by the battle fleet astern; that order denied the British heavy torpedo attack at the very moment when they most wanted it. At about 18:30 the 1st and 2nd Battlecruiser Squadrons passed through the gap between the German battlecruisers and the German battle line in the run through the T, but instead of concentrating eight guns on one target they split into sections each pursuing a different enemy ship, and that dispersal of fire has been criticised ever since. Once the battle lines engaged, Jellicoe turned the fleet away at 17:55 and about-turned again around 19:00 to attack the German line from astern, and the crossing fire of the capital ships was among the largest salvos of the day. At night the Germans mounted torpedo attacks with their destroyers; the British declined to accept action in poor visibility and instead met the torpedo boats with a dispersed screen, and on the way home Lützow grounded on the mud flats off the west coast of Jutland, becoming one of the worst single-ship disasters of the battle in terms of casualties.
data: 數字可以說明雙方的差距與代價。戰鬥自五月三十一日下午起至六月一日清晨止，白晝交火約兩小時。德方陣亡四千四百五十一人、受傷二千四百三十三人、被俘五千零二十七人；英方陣亡六千七百八十四人、受傷一萬六千五百九十七人、被俘一百七十七人。艦艇方面，英方損失大型戰鬥巡洋艦不屈號與瑪麗皇后號、輕巡洋艦無畏號與無敵號，裝甲巡洋艦戰士號、黑騎士號與防禦號，輕巡洋艦法爾茅斯號，以及數艘驅逐艦；德方損失戰鬥巡洋艦塞德利茨號與德弗林格（重傷擱淺返港）、輕巡洋艦布雷斯勞號與法蘭克福號、岸防艦蓬默恩號與舊式主力艦石勒蘇益格－荷爾斯泰因號，另有多艘驅逐艦受創，擱淺的「盧措號」傷亡尤重。雄獅號本身中彈十四發，其中六發為大口徑，陣亡九人、受傷二十五人，最大航速由二十五節跌到十七節，經羅西思基地修理後於同年九月返回戰線。距離與環境方面，戰場在日德蘭半島以西約六十至一百海里，主交戰區約在北緯五十七度三十分、東經四度一帶，能見度因海霧與硝煙反覆在六至十海里之間轉換；雄獅號首次開火距離約一萬八千碼，砲彈重一千四百磅，十三又二分之一吋砲有效射程約兩萬碼。不屈號一千餘名乘員中僅三人生還，無畏號爆炸時同樣只有少數人獲救。就交換比而言，以艦數計德方損失較重，以噸位計則英方損失較重。
dataEn: The figures explain both the gap between the fleets and the price paid. The action ran from the afternoon of the thirty-first of May to the early hours of the first of June, with about two hours of daylight fighting. The Germans lost 4,451 killed, 2,433 wounded and 5,027 taken prisoner; the British lost 6,784 killed, 16,597 wounded and 177 captured. In ships, the British lost the large battlecruisers Indefatigable and Queen Mary, the light cruisers Invincible and Inflexible, the armoured cruisers Warrior, Black Prince and Defence, the light cruiser Falmouth and several destroyers. The Germans lost the battlecruisers Seydlitz and Derfflinger, both badly damaged and unable to continue, the light cruisers Breslau and Frankfurt, the coastal defence ship Pommern and the old battleship Schleswig-Holstein, with several destroyers damaged as well and the grounded Lützow suffering casualties out of all proportion. The Lion herself took fourteen hits, six of them heavy-calibre, and had nine men killed and twenty-five wounded; her speed fell from 25 knots to 17, and after repairs at Rosyth she returned to the line in September of the same year. On distances and conditions, the battleground lay sixty to one hundred miles west of the Jutland peninsula, the main engagement area being around 57 degrees 30 minutes north and 4 degrees east, with visibility swinging between six and ten miles as haze and smoke came and went. The Lion's first salvo was fired at about 18,000 yards, her shell weighed 1,400 pounds and the 13.5-inch gun had an effective range of some 20,000 yards. Of more than a thousand men in Indefatigable only three survived, and when Invincible blew up only a handful were pulled out of the water. In the exchange the Germans lost the greater number of ships, while the British lost the greater tonnage.
cause: 打起上來的根由有三層。最表層是德國的潛艇戰役與英國的封鎖：1916 年 3 月 1 日德國在「薩塞克斯號」事件後恢復無限制潛艇戰役，企圖以切斷英國海上命脈迫使其求和，北海因此成為英國大艦隊封鎖線與德國潛艇獵殺區重疊的所在，任何一方都無法容忍對方在近海自由活動。第二層是公海艦隊一次大規模出動的計畫：德國計畫在 1916 年內以公海艦隊主力在北海與英國大艦隊決戰，利用德方十二吋砲射程較長、艦隊集中射擊較佳的優點削弱英軍戰列線，再以潛艇與夜襲魚雷完成決戰。計畫的核心障礙是英國快速分遣的存在：英軍把最快的戰鬥巡洋艦集中在北面，一旦德軍分出戰鬥巡洋艦突進，就必須分兵以保護主力，這正是德方在計畫中難以解決的兩難。第三層是雙方對戰鬥巡洋艦的信仰：雄獅號這一級戰鬥巡洋艦把主力艦的火砲裝在主力艦的裝甲之上，設計上認定對方會因忌憚傷亡而退讓，結果反而鼓勵英方在每次遭遇中逕自逼近，把速度用在追擊而不是脫離。於是當五月二十四日英軍偵察分隊在日德蘭海峽與德軍前哨接觸、比蒂奉命出擊時，兩支互不信任的隊伍終於在濃霧中迎面撞上，計畫上的邊際爭議就此變成十八門大口徑砲的實際對話。
causeEn: Three layers lie behind the outbreak. The outermost is the German submarine campaign and the British blockade. On the first of March 1916, after the Sussex incident, Germany resumed unrestricted submarine warfare, seeking to cut Britain's sea communications and force a negotiated peace; the North Sea therefore became the place where the British blockade line and the German hunting grounds for shipping overlapped, and neither side could tolerate the other operating freely close inshore. The second layer is the German plan for a major sortie by the High Seas Fleet: to bring the fleet out into the North Sea in 1916 and fight the Grand Fleet, using the longer reach of the German twelve-inch guns and the better concentration of fire of a fleet deployed in line to weaken the British battle line, and then to complete the decision with submarines and a night torpedo attack. The central obstacle to that plan was the existence of the British fast detached force. The Royal Navy concentrated its fastest battlecruisers in the north, so the moment Germany detached battlecruisers to push in, it had to split its force to protect the fleet, and that was the dilemma the German plan could not solve. The third layer is the shared belief in the battlecruiser. A ship like the Lion mounted capital-ship guns on capital-ship displacement while carrying armour the designers expected the enemy to hesitate to cross; instead of deterring the enemy it encouraged the British to close in at every opportunity, spending speed on pursuit rather than on escape. So when on the twenty-fourth of May the British detached force met the German outposts in the Skagerrak and Beatty was sent out to attack, the two fleets that distrusted each other met face to face in the haze, and the marginal arguments of the plan turned into an actual exchange between eighteen heavy guns.
impact: 日德蘭在戰術上偏向英方，在戰略上卻沒有改變任何東西。德國公海艦隊此後再未主動出港尋戰，主力艦隊直到 1918 年停戰都龜縮在波羅的海與北海入海口，戰爭最後兩年德國的海軍戰略轉為無限制潛艇戰役，而那條路線最終在一九一七年破產——潛艇戰役未能擊垮英國，美國參戰反而替英國的封鎖添了援軍。英國那邊得到的教訓同樣殘酷：戰鬥巡洋艦這種速度與裝甲的取捨被判定為走得太遠，倫敦的軍令圈子相信英國在戰鬥巡洋艦對決中承受了不成比例的損失，海軍部於是推動快速主力艦的設計，第五戰鬥艦支隊隨後成軍，此後的國家級主力艦把重點由裝甲轉向火砲射程；1922 年《華盛頓海軍條約》把主力艦噸位限制在三萬五千噸、限制裝備十六吋砲，也等於替這場戰役的取捨下了結論。人事上，約翰・費舍爾於 1917 年辭去第一海務大臣一職，傑利科伊接任。此役的記憶在兩國內部走向相反：德國把它寫成日德蘭神話，用來支撐海軍的重建；英國則長期為官方戰史的取捨爭論不休，修正派與劍橋派各執一端。一九一六年之後沉入海底的殘骸成為戰爭紀念地，獅子號的殘骸與散落物至今躺在日德蘭西岸外海，被列為受保護的英國海軍墓地。
impactEn: Jutland went tactically to the British and strategically to no one at all. The German High Seas Fleet never again put to sea in search of a decision, and the capital ships stayed bottled up in the Baltic and at the entrances to the North Sea until the armistice of 1918; in the last two years of the war German naval strategy turned entirely to unrestricted submarine warfare, and that line finally broke down in 1917, when the submarine campaign failed to bring Britain down and American entry strengthened the blockade instead. The lessons the British drew were just as bitter. The exchange of speed for armour in the battlecruiser was judged to have gone too far; the circle in Whitehall believed the Royal Navy had taken a disproportionate share of the losses in the battlecruiser duel, and the Admiralty drove the design of fast capital ships, the 5th Battle Squadron being formed afterwards, with national battleship design from then on turning from protection to gun range. The Washington Naval Treaty of 1922 capped the battleship at 35,000 tons and forbade the sixteen-inch gun, which settled the argument this battle had opened. On personnel, John Fisher resigned as First Sea Lord in 1917 and Jellicoe took over from him. The memory of the battle runs in opposite directions in the two countries: Germany turned it into the Jutland myth to underwrite the rebuilding of its navy, while in Britain the official history and its revisions were argued over for decades, with the Cambridge school and its critics each holding their ground. The wrecks left on the seabed after 1916 became places of remembrance, and the remains and scattered debris of the Lion still lie off the west coast of Jutland, listed as a protected Royal Navy war grave.
result: 點完的樣貌是：德軍撤退，英軍沒有追上。五月三十一日二十時左右，舍爾下令公海艦隊退回基地，傑利科伊追到北海雷區邊緣即止，因為在夜間劣視距下接受一場魚雷夜戰風險太大；六月一日凌晨德軍驅逐艦仍發動數次魚雷突擊，英方以警戒幕與驅逐艦攔截，天亮前雙方各自返航。雄獅號當晚即退向羅西思，修理後於九月重返大艦隊，此後再未遭遇主力對決。就交換比而言，英國擊沉或擊傷德軍的艦艇與兵員更多，以艦數計德方損失較重；以噸位計則英方損失較重，因為不屈號、瑪麗皇后號、無畏號、無敵號四艘大型快速主力艦同時沉沒。就戰果計，英方沒有取得任何可以作為勝利象徵的德軍主力艦，德方也沒有被壓制到放棄潛艇戰役的境地。英國的實際收穫是：以一次高傷亡的戰鬥確認了德國公海艦隊不會再主動挑戰，於是能安心把主力艦隊用於監視封鎖。德國的實際收穫是：主力艦隊保住了，卻也保住了再不打就永遠不會打的尷尬，最終在一九一九年六月十日於斯卡帕灣由艦員自行鑿沉。就兵器而言，這場戰役的殘骸成了一堂關於裝甲與生存的課：艙門能不能關上、裝藥紀律能不能守住、砲塔起火能不能及時注水，比任何一次射擊的命中數更能決定旗艦的命運。
resultEn: The shape of the outcome was this: the Germans withdrew and the British did not follow them through. At about 20:00 on the thirty-first of May Scheer ordered the High Seas Fleet back to port, and Jellicoe stopped at the edge of the North Sea minefields, for accepting a torpedo night action in poor visibility carried a risk out of all proportion to the prize; in the early hours of the first of June the German destroyers still made several torpedo attacks, met by the British screen and destroyers, and before dawn the two fleets returned separately to their own bases. The Lion went back to Rosyth that same night, was repaired, and rejoined the Grand Fleet in September, never again meeting a capital fleet in action. In the exchange the British sank or damaged more German ships and took more German prisoners, and in numbers of ships the Germans lost more; in tonnage the British lost more, because four large fast capital ships, Indefatigable, Queen Mary, Invincible and Inflexible, went down together. In terms of results the British captured no German capital ship that could serve as a symbol of victory, and the Germans were not so worn down as to abandon the submarine campaign. What the British actually gained was a battle that confirmed, at heavy cost, that the German High Seas Fleet would not again seek a decision, and so the Grand Fleet could be used to watch the blockade. What the Germans actually gained was the survival of the fleet, together with the embarrassment of never daring to fight again, and in the end their own crews scuttled it at Scapa Flow on the tenth of June 1919. In the matter of weapons, the wreckage of this battle became a lesson in armour and survival: whether a magazine door could be closed, whether the discipline of loading could be held, whether a turret fire could be flooded in time, decided the fate of a flagship far more than any tally of hits.
